caption: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. Golden tonkotsu broth, chashu pork, and nori seaweed create a rich, warm scene with delicate textures and soft lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table with smooth grain and subtle wear
Glistening chashu pork with tender, marbled texture and slight sheen
Dark nori seaweed curled into thin, crisp edges with a matte finish
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth glows golden with fine bubbles and gentle ripples
White floral bowl with soft petals and slightly textured surface
White ceramic spoon with smooth edges and a slightly worn handle
